# Version 3.119.3
> **Native loading and AOT reliability** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/3.119.3-preview.1.1)

> **Superseded by [3.119.4](3.119.4.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 3.119.4.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](3.119.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.4/index.md)

## Highlights

The 3.119.3 preview fixes Linux ARM64 loading and reflection-disabled AOT initialization. Bundled image and compression dependencies are refreshed, with additional Spectre mitigation flags for native SkiaSharp binaries.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux ARM64 font loading** — Correctly links the fontconfig runtime library, fixing native crashes involving the unresolved uuid_generate_random symbol. ([#3494](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3494))
- **AOT initialization without reflection** — SKBlender no longer uses reflection to enumerate blend modes during static initialization, avoiding TypeInitializationException when IlcDisableReflection=true. ([#3485](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3485))

## Security

- **Refreshed bundled dependencies** — Updates libpng to 1.6.54, libwebp to 1.6.0, Brotli to 1.2.0, and libexpat to 2.7.3. The Brotli and libexpat updates address reported decompression and parser issues. ([#3452](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3452), [#3478](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3478), [#3469](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3469), [#3458](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3458))
- **Spectre mitigation build flags** — Enables Spectre mitigation options for native SkiaSharp on Windows and Linux, using architecture-specific flags on Linux. — ❤️ [@sshumakov](https://github.com/sshumakov) ([#3496](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3496), [#3502](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3502))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.4

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
